criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

Create Pen 200/4, Book 500/8 and Bag 4000/0 in a disposable database. Record primary keys and clear only your practice rows when repeating. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Query stock <=4 ordered by stock then id. Expect Bag and Pen. Save Python and output, then check threshold 0. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use get(pk=...) for Pen and catch Product.DoesNotExist for a missing ID. Explain why filter returns an empty QuerySet instead of raising for no match. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use an F expression to increase Pen stock by 3, then refresh_from_db. Expect 7. Explain why an already loaded object can show an older value. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use ORM aggregation to calculate the total stock units after the update: 15. Define empty-queryset behaviour and demonstrate it. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use Django query capture in a test or shell to compare building a QuerySet with evaluating it. Save query counts and explain evaluation triggers. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Fetch only names and stock with values() or values_list(), then compare output types with model instances. Show explicit ordering and explain when this projection helps. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
